title: Construct Binary Tree from Inorder and Postorder Traversal
statement:
Given two integer arrays `inorder` and `postorder` where `inorder` is the inorder traversal of a binary tree and `postorder` is the postorder traversal of the same tree, construct and return the binary tree.

The output should be the Level-order traversal array of the constructed tree.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers representing the `inorder` array.
Line 3: N space-separated integers representing the `postorder` array.
outputFormat: Space-separated strings mapping the level-order traversal of the built tree.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 3000
-3000 <= inorder[i], postorder[i] <= 3000
inorder and postorder consist of unique values.
Each value of postorder also appears in inorder.
inorder is guaranteed to be the inorder traversal of the tree.

examples.explanation: Root is 3 (last in postorder). Left subtree inorder [9], postorder [9]. Right subtree inorder [15, 20, 7], postorder [15, 7, 20].

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
inorder = list(map(int, input().split()))
postorder = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Implement tree construction

testCases.expectedOutput: 10 null 20 null null null 30 null null null null null null null 40
